actions.create-task.description: Creates a new task in a project.
actions.create-task.props.projectId.desc: The ID of the project to create the task in.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.start-timer.description: Starts a timer for a specific task.
actions.start-timer.props.taskId.descrip: The ID of the task to start the timer for.
actions.stop-timer.description: Stops the currently running timer. Fails if no timer is currently active.
auth.description: You can find your API key by going to **Settings -> API** in Everhour.
description: Time tracking software that integrates into project management tools to track billable hours, set budgets, and monitor spending.
